blocks.text: Affordable SEO tool for startups getting started with organic growth

Ubersuggest, created by Neil Patel, positions itself as the accessible entry point to SEO tooling. While Ahrefs and SEMrush are comprehensive but expensive, Ubersuggest provides the core functionality most small businesses need at a fraction of the price - including a lifetime purchase option that eliminates recurring costs entirely.

The keyword research tools cover the essentials: search volume, SEO difficulty, paid difficulty, and content ideas. For teams new to SEO, the suggestions are actionable rather than overwhelming. Ubersuggest tells you which keywords to target and shows you what currently ranks for them.
The site audit feature identifies technical SEO issues with clear explanations and fix recommendations. For non-technical website owners, this guidance is more useful than a raw technical report.
Search volume, difficulty, and related keyword suggestions
Technical SEO analysis with prioritized fix recommendations
See competitors' top keywords and traffic sources
Find content topics based on what is performing in your niche
Analyze backlink profiles and find linking opportunities
See SEO data directly in Google search results

For startups that are not ready for the cost of premium SEO tools, Ubersuggest provides enough functionality to build and execute a basic SEO strategy. The lifetime pricing makes it a one-time investment.
Our team can integrate Ubersuggest into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
